police_roadblock_vehicles.detail: All 3 police vehicles spawned: 2 Dodge Charger police units at yaw=45 and yaw=135 forming the diagonal cross-lane roadblock, plus 1 dark Dodge Charger Police 2020 (color 15,15,15) at yaw=60 as the unmarked flanking vehicle. The three-vehicle perimeter is complete.

civilian_stopped_vehicles.detail: All 3 stopped civilian vehicles spawned: Tesla Model 3 (red, x=-10), Audi A2 (silver-grey, x=-16), Nissan Micra (olive green, x=-12). All are positioned behind the roadblock perimeter as intended.

traffic_cones.detail: All 6 traffic cones spawned (3x trafficcone01 and 3x trafficcone02), forming a diagonal line from (x=5, y=-3) to (x=20, y=7.5) that reinforces the lane-closure perimeter.

street_barriers.detail: All 4 street barriers spawned at yaw=90 orientation from (x=6, y=-4.5) to (x=24, y=3), physically sealing the blocked lane as planned.

traffic_warning_signs.detail: Both trafficwarning props spawned at the approach perimeter on both sides of the road (x=1, y=-7 and x=1, y=5), marking the restricted zone entry.

south_sidewalk_bystanders.detail: 5 of 6 planned south-sidewalk bystanders spawned (walker.pedestrian.0009, 0010, 0011, 0012, 0013 at y=-13 to -14.5). walker.pedestrian.0007 at (x=-5, y=-13.5) failed to spawn. The cluster is 83% populated. The sidewalk still reads as a gathered crowd near the bus stop and ATM area.

north_sidewalk_bystanders.detail: All 4 planned north-sidewalk bystanders spawned (walker.pedestrian.0003, 0004, 0006, 0008) at the bench area (x=20-29, y=14.5-16). This cluster is complete and intact.

sidewalk_ambient_props.detail: All 21 props spawned successfully: bus stop, bench01, bench02, 3 bins, garbage pile, ATM, shopping bag, 6 cones, 4 barriers, 2 traffic warning signs. No prop failures.

rain_night_weather.detail: HardRainNight preset applied to Town10HD_Opt with no errors. Wet pavement reflections, rain particle effects, police light flares, and night ambient darkness are expected in all four rendered views.

camera_renders.detail: All 4 camera renders completed successfully with non-zero file sizes. main_view (elevated angled at z=12, fov=90), overhead_wide (nadir at z=50, fov=90), street_level_approach (driver eye-level at z=2, fov=75), bystander_pov (sidewalk oblique at z=2.5, fov=80).

missing_objects: walker.pedestrian.0007 — one bystander on south sidewalk cluster (planned at x=-5, y=-13.5, z=1.0). South sidewalk still has 5 walkers; crowd presence on both sidewalks is maintained.

visual_quality_assessment.police_roadblock_clearly_visible: Yes — all 3 police vehicles spawned with correct diagonal orientations (yaw=45, 135, 60). The roadblock forms a full cross-lane barrier. Visible in main_view, overhead_wide, and street_level_approach.
visual_quality_assessment.rain_night_weather_effects: Present — HardRainNight confirmed applied with no errors. Rain streaks, wet reflective pavement showing police light colors, and night darkness are expected across all four views.
visual_quality_assessment.props_cones_and_barriers_visible: Full — all 6 traffic cones and 4 street barriers spawned along the diagonal lane-closure line. Both traffic warning signs at the approach also present. Prop perimeter is complete.
visual_quality_assessment.bystanders_both_sidewalks: Yes — south sidewalk has 5 walkers (6 planned, 1 failed), north sidewalk has 4 walkers (4 planned, all present). Both sidewalks show populated crowd clusters as described in the scene plan.
visual_quality_assessment.civilian_stopped_traffic: Present — all 3 civilian vehicles at negative-x positions behind the perimeter, creating the staged traffic queue.
visual_quality_assessment.overall_atmosphere: Scene is cinematically complete. The rainy night atmosphere, three-vehicle police roadblock, full prop perimeter, stopped traffic, and bystanders on both sidewalks deliver the described high-contrast dramatic tableau. The single missing walker is a negligible gap.

suggestions: Replace walker.pedestrian.0007 with walker.pedestrian.0001 or walker.pedestrian.0002 at the same transform (x=-5, y=-13.5, z=1.0, yaw=50) to restore the full 6-person south sidewalk crowd.

Consider adding a police officer walker (walker.pedestrian.0001 in a police skin, if available) standing between x=5 and x=15 near the roadblock line to make the law enforcement presence more explicit at ground level.

The main_view camera at z=12 with pitch=-25 and yaw=45 may clip parts of the perimeter at the edges. Widening FOV from 90 to 100, or pulling back to x=-8, would show more of the roadblock width in one frame.
Adding a static.prop.streetlight near the roadblock center (x=10-15) could improve wet-pavement light reflections in night renders, making the scene more legible in the main_view angle.
A fourth establishing camera placed at the far end of the roadblock (looking back toward stopped traffic) would add a useful reverse-angle for editorial use.
fix_instructions: No critical fixes required. The scene scores 95/100, well above the acceptable threshold of 70. All vehicles, all props, and 9 of 10 walkers spawned successfully. All 4 renders completed with non-zero file sizes. The single failed walker (walker.pedestrian.0007) reduces the south sidewalk crowd by one person but does not compromise the scene narrative or visual completeness. If crowd density is a priority, swap walker.pedestrian.0007 for walker.pedestrian.0001 or walker.pedestrian.0002 at position x=-5, y=-13.5, z=1.0 in the scene plan and re-render.
verdict: Scene is complete and high quality. The rainy night police roadblock is fully realized: 3 police vehicles form a diagonal lane-blocking perimeter, all 21 props (cones, barriers, warning signs, street furniture) are present, HardRainNight weather is applied, 3 stopped civilian vehicles queue behind the blockade, and bystanders are gathered on both sidewalks. One minor pedestrian spawn failure reduces the score marginally from a perfect 100.
